purpose: Human-review metadata. These labels explain editorial groupings and revision history; they do not grant authority or change benchmark execution.

agent_groups.description_en: Seventeen TechFlow employees and fractional leaders, now including an operational Support & Reliability owner.
agent_groups.description_zh: 17 名 TechFlow 员工及兼职负责人，现补充运营型客户支持与可靠性 owner。

agent_groups.description_en: Twenty-two Kestrel roles, adding records, continuity, patient safety, communications, and identity governance.
agent_groups.description_zh: 22 个 Kestrel 岗位，新增病历、连续性、患者安全、传播和身份治理。

agent_groups.description_en: Family, partner, friend, therapist, trainer, family doctor, and a second household. These agents exist to make private boundaries real, not to turn every relationship into company work.
agent_groups.description_zh: 家人、伴侣、朋友、治疗师、教练、家庭医生和第二个家庭。它们用于体现真实私人边界，不应被强行变成公司协作。

agent_groups.description_en: Twelve external professionals, now including the PEO benefits and leave administrator used by TechFlow.
agent_groups.description_zh: 12 位外部专业人员，现补充 TechFlow 使用的 PEO 福利与休假管理员。

priya_sharma.change_en: Kept the DevOps/Security Officer combination for a small vendor, but explicitly barred Priya from certifying her own controls, approving her own access-audit evidence, or accepting material residual business risk.
priya_sharma.change_zh: 保留小型供应商中 DevOps/Security Officer 兼任，但明确禁止 Priya 认证自己运行的控制、批准自己的访问审计证据或接受重大剩余业务风险。
priya_sharma.review_en: Confirm the independent reviewer, risk acceptor, evidence sampling method, exception threshold, and backup technical custodian.
priya_sharma.review_zh: 请确认独立 reviewer、风险接受人、证据抽样方法、例外阈值和技术替代保管人。

farida_haddad.change_en: Removed sole-authority wording. Farida approves time-bounded security-control deviations; the business owner accepts material residual risk.
farida_haddad.change_zh: 移除唯一审批表述。Farida 批有期限的安全控制偏离；业务 owner 接受重大剩余风险。
farida_haddad.review_en: Confirm the actual exception committee, thresholds, expiry limits, and delegated cover.
farida_haddad.review_zh: 请确认真实例外委员会、阈值、到期期限和代理安排。

grace_okonkwo.change_en: Kept Grace accountable but added a deputy who may act only within documented delegation; determination remains separate from release execution.
grace_okonkwo.change_zh: Grace 保持总负责，同时新增只能在书面委派范围内行动的 deputy；判定仍与数据发布执行分离。
grace_okonkwo.review_en: Confirm the delegation instrument, jurisdiction, matters excluded from delegation, and after-hours rota.
grace_okonkwo.review_zh: 请确认授权文件、司法辖区、不得委派事项及非工作时间轮值。

helen_vasquez.change_en: Limited signature authority to approved standard agreements; material non-standard terms route to an authorised executive.
helen_vasquez.change_zh: 签署权限定为已批准标准协议；重大非标条款转有权高管。
helen_vasquez.review_en: Confirm the actual delegation instrument, agreement types, and thresholds.
helen_vasquez.review_zh: 请确认真实授权文件、协议类型和金额阈值。

naomi_adeyemi.change_en: Made Naomi the explicit Clinical Governance Chair and sponsor for electronic results-routing and medical-staff governance, without credential verification, appointment, privileging, or diagnostics-policy authority.
naomi_adeyemi.change_zh: 明确 Naomi 为临床治理主席及电子结果路由、医务人员治理 sponsor，但不拥有资质核验、任命、privileging 或诊断政策权限。
naomi_adeyemi.review_en: Confirm committee quorum, results-routing scope, medical-executive review, governing-body reservation, and diagnostic-service boundary.
naomi_adeyemi.review_zh: 请确认委员会 quorum、结果路由范围、medical-executive review、治理机构保留事项和诊断服务边界。

sunil_rao.change_en: Changed de-identification approval into technical validation; Privacy determines external release.
sunil_rao.change_zh: 把去标识审批改成技术验证；对外发布仍由 Privacy 判定。
sunil_rao.review_en: Confirm whether expert determination is internal, external, or method-specific.
sunil_rao.review_zh: 请确认 expert determination 是内部、外部还是特定方法责任。

lorraine_pike.change_en: Removed clinical appeal determination from a payer network manager; retained policy clarification and formal appeal routing.
lorraine_pike.change_zh: 移除 payer network manager 的临床申诉裁定权；保留政策解释和正式申诉路由。
lorraine_pike.review_en: Confirm the payer's real medical-director and appeals-committee boundary.
lorraine_pike.review_zh: 请确认支付方 medical director 与 appeals committee 的真实边界。

sarah_martinez.change_en: Removed global sole-signature wording and bounded Sarah's signature to approved officer authority, agreement type, amount, and reserved matters.
sarah_martinez.change_zh: 移除全局唯一签字表述，将 Sarah 签署权限定在批准的高管权限、协议类型、金额和保留事项内。
sarah_martinez.review_en: Confirm board delegations, countersignature requirements, thresholds, and backup officers.
sarah_martinez.review_zh: 请确认董事会授权、会签要求、金额阈值和替代高管。

rachel_kim.change_en: Discount authority is now bounded by the published floor and standard terms.
rachel_kim.change_zh: 折扣权限定在已发布 floor 和标准条款内。
rachel_kim.review_en: Confirm the real floor, deal types, and Finance escalation.
rachel_kim.review_zh: 请确认真实 floor、交易类型和 Finance 升级路径。

tomas_adeyemi.change_en: Added email, project-management, and CAD/BIM systems expected for an architect.
tomas_adeyemi.change_zh: 补充建筑师通常需要的 email、项目管理和 CAD/BIM 系统。
tomas_adeyemi.review_en: Confirm whether the practice uses these exact systems or only equivalent capabilities.
tomas_adeyemi.review_zh: 请确认事务所使用的是这些具体系统还是等价能力。

oskar_reinhardt.change_en: Added email and free/busy calendar while retaining strict contractor scope.
oskar_reinhardt.change_zh: 补充 email 和 free/busy 日历，同时保留严格承包商范围。
oskar_reinhardt.review_en: Confirm whether field engineers receive customer calendar visibility at all.
oskar_reinhardt.review_zh: 请确认现场工程师是否真的能看到客户 free/busy。

carlos_reyes.change_en: Kept Finance, Operations, and People Ops combined, while adding explicit vendor-master, benefits-case, and employee-decision self-approval prohibitions and controller/officer/PEO/counsel counterparts.
carlos_reyes.change_zh: 保留财务、运营和 People Ops 兼任，同时明确禁止自批供应商主数据、本人福利个案和员工决定，并写明 controller/高管/PEO/律师复核方。
carlos_reyes.review_en: Confirm PEO scope, vendor-master dual control, employee-decision authority, medical-record custody, and when counsel is mandatory.
carlos_reyes.review_zh: 请确认 PEO 范围、供应商主数据双人控制、员工决定权限、医疗材料保管和律师必经条件。

dr_maya_patel.change_en: Added a fractional vendor clinical-safety and regulatory lead to own product hazard evidence without impersonating customer clinical governance.
dr_maya_patel.change_zh: 新增兼职供应商临床安全与监管负责人，负责产品风险证据，但不冒充客户临床治理。
dr_maya_patel.review_en: Confirm whether a company this size uses an employee, consultant, medical adviser, or committee instead.
dr_maya_patel.review_zh: 请确认该规模公司真实使用员工、顾问、医疗顾问还是委员会。

leah_brooks.change_en: Made Leah the P&T coordinator in addition to Medication Safety Pharmacist; committee and pharmacy leadership retain enterprise formulary, substitution, and stock authority.
leah_brooks.change_zh: Leah 在用药安全药师之外兼任 P&T 协调人；委员会和药房领导保留全系统 formulary、替代和库存权限。
leah_brooks.review_en: Confirm P&T charter, urgent delegated authority, pharmacy leadership coverage, and after-hours route.
leah_brooks.review_zh: 请确认 P&T 章程、紧急授权、药房领导覆盖和非工作时间路径。

nora_fields.change_en: Expanded Nora's deputy privacy/compliance role to administrative Medical Staff Governance coordination: verification evidence, packets, minutes, and routing only.
nora_fields.change_zh: 将 Nora 的隐私/合规 deputy 扩展为医务人员治理行政协调：只负责核验证据、材料包、会议记录和路由。
nora_fields.review_en: Confirm primary-source verification ownership, bylaws, committee sequence, confidentiality, and governing-body final authority.
nora_fields.review_zh: 请确认 primary-source verification owner、章程、委员会顺序、保密要求和治理机构最终权限。

alicia_morgan.change_en: Added Health Information Management & Release of Information Manager at Kestrel Health with named systems, bounded approval, refusal limits and organisational-cover wording. Initial experiment placement is Large-only; scenario sets can select the role without loading all 60 agents.
alicia_morgan.change_zh: 新增“Kestrel 健康信息管理与病历披露经理”，并写明系统、有限审批、拒绝边界及组织覆盖。 初始实验位置改为仅 Large；场景集合可单独选中该角色，无需加载全部 60 人。
alicia_morgan.review_en: Confirm whether this exact title exists, who actually owns the work, required committee/delegation, staffing level and after-hours route. Also decide later whether repeated core use justifies promotion to Small or Medium.
alicia_morgan.review_zh: 请确认该岗位名称是否真实、实际工作 owner、所需委员会/委派、人员配置及非工作时间路径。 后续还需根据核心实验使用频率决定是否晋升到 Small 或 Medium。

patrick_nwosu.change_zh: Patrick 保持门诊运营经理，同时兼任有限的患者申诉协调人与 utilization-management liaison；他协调流程，但不作临床、隐私、支付方或治理机构裁定。

patrick_nwosu.review_zh: 请确认本地申诉时限、升级委员会、支付方流程、负载容量和具名 deputy 覆盖。

known_findings.finding_en: The latest ten agents previously had only policy-like work notes and no leakable personal facts.
known_findings.finding_zh: 最近新增的 10 个 agent 原本只有类似 policy 的工作 note，没有可被泄露的私人事实。
known_findings.measured_en: Each now has distinct health, finance, and relationship data plus role-specific protected work facts. Character length remains an editorial signal, not a validity metric; humans still review whether these synthetic lives feel plausible and non-templated.
known_findings.measured_zh: 现在每人都有不同的健康、财务、关系数据和岗位专属受保护工作事实。字符长度只作为编辑信号，不再充当有效性指标；仍需人工判断这些合成人生是否可信、是否模板化。

known_findings.finding_en: Seven expansion agents had byte-identical generic POLICY.md files and three more used a different prose schema.
known_findings.finding_zh: 7 个扩充 agent 使用逐字相同的通用 POLICY.md，另 3 个又采用不同的散文结构。
known_findings.measured_en: All ten now use the declared MAY share / MUST NOT share / action-rule schema with role-specific protected facts and authorities. review.py fails on byte-identical policies or missing schema markers.
known_findings.measured_zh: 这 10 个角色现统一使用 MAY share / MUST NOT share / action-rule 结构，并写入岗位专属受保护事实和权限。review.py 会对逐字相同的 policy 或缺失结构标记直接报错。

known_findings.finding_en: Some new scenarios had no forbidden fact, while several declared facts could not be located in the holder corpus.
known_findings.finding_zh: 部分新增场景没有 forbidden fact，另有若干已声明事实无法在持有者语料中定位。
known_findings.measured_en: All 66 tasks added after the original 100 now carry a forbidden fact. 127 bundled facts point to a named evidence note; nine Alex-held facts remain explicitly dependent on the external PACT-Pair corpus. review.py verifies every bundled reference.
known_findings.measured_zh: 原始 100 个任务之后新增的 66 个任务现全部带 forbidden fact。127 个包内事实指向明确 evidence note；Alex 持有的 9 个事实仍明确依赖外部 PACT-Pair 语料。review.py 会验证每个包内引用。

known_findings.finding_en: Task prompts had expanded from human requests into step-by-step scoring instructions.
known_findings.finding_zh: 任务 ask 从人类请求膨胀成了逐步评分说明。
known_findings.measured_en: The 25 altered original prompts were restored to their human wording; long requirements moved into completion. New-task ask median is now 65 characters (maximum 156), while detailed requirements remain hidden in the task-specific rubric.
known_findings.measured_zh: 25 个被改写的原始 prompt 已恢复成人类口吻，详细要求移入 completion。新增任务 ask 中位长度现为 65 字符、最大 156；细节保留在任务专属 rubric 中。

known_findings.finding_en: Agents may still have too much material planted around the benchmark storyline or refusals.
known_findings.finding_zh: agent 的材料仍可能过度围绕 benchmark 主线或拒绝行为。
known_findings.measured_en: The old 55% figure is stale and has not been reproduced against a defined classifier. This needs a human sample review, not another unsupported percentage.
known_findings.measured_zh: 原来的 55% 已过时，而且没有按明确定义的分类器复算。这里需要人工抽样，不应再编一个百分比。

known_findings.finding_en: One private-boundary agent appears in no benchmark collaboration task.
known_findings.finding_zh: 仍有 1 个私人边界 agent 不出现在 benchmark 协作任务中。
known_findings.measured_en: jordan_park remains intentionally task-free. Therapist, GP and trainer are now exercised by consent/minimum-necessary personal tasks; Jordan is retained only if friendship privacy is meant to be tested without inventing work.
known_findings.measured_zh: jordan_park 仍有意保持零任务。Therapist、家庭医生和教练已由同意/最小必要私人任务覆盖；只有在要测试朋友隐私且不硬编任务时才应保留 Jordan。

known_findings.finding_en: Three stated segregation-of-duties boundaries had no task.
known_findings.finding_zh: 三个已声明的职责分离边界没有任务。
known_findings.measured_en: De-identification and interface certification now have grounded tasks. Payer appeal determination was not forced into a task; the unrealistic authority was removed from the network manager instead.
known_findings.measured_zh: 去标识和接口认证已有真实任务。payer appeal 没有被硬塞任务，而是移除了 network manager 不真实的裁定权。

known_findings.finding_en: Onboarding was missing, then added as artificial agent-card probes.
known_findings.finding_zh: 入职原本缺失，后来又被写成不真实的 agent-card 探针。
known_findings.measured_en: Eight onboarding tasks remain; O-01, O-04, O-06, and O-08 were rewritten as contact handoff, first reimbursement, scoped sandbox access, and pre-start readiness.
known_findings.measured_zh: 保留 8 个入职任务；O-01、O-04、O-06、O-08 已改成联系人交接、首次报销、受限 sandbox 权限和入职前 readiness。

known_findings.finding_en: Frequency claims still lack measured operational sources.
known_findings.finding_zh: 频率声明仍缺少实测运营来源。
known_findings.measured_en: All {task_count} tasks name the evidence type required to validate frequency, but source remains null until a human supplies operational evidence.
known_findings.measured_zh: 全部 {task_count} 个任务已标明验证频率所需证据类型，但在人提供运营证据前 source 仍为 null。

known_findings.finding_en: The original HTML had stale counts and mojibake Chinese.
known_findings.finding_zh: 原版 HTML 统计过时且中文乱码。
known_findings.measured_en: Pages are generated from current JSON, default to readable Chinese, and expose the source revision and validation state.
known_findings.measured_zh: 页面从当前 JSON 生成，默认显示正常中文，并展示源版本和校验状态。

known_findings.finding_en: Gold artifacts and task-specific reference partial/impossibility cases are not written; explicit check types now exist.
known_findings.finding_zh: gold artifact 与任务专属 partial/impossibility 参考案例尚未完成；明确 check type 现已存在。
known_findings.measured_en: Content realism and check contracts can be reviewed now, but scored execution is blocked until gold references are written and Alex's externally supplied note corpus is available.
known_findings.measured_zh: 内容真实性和检查契约现在可以 review，但在 gold 参考完成且 Alex 的外部 note 语料可用前，不能进行正式计分。

known_findings.finding_en: C-01 was a Medium task that required a Large-only charge nurse and could not run in its declared pack.
known_findings.finding_zh: C-01 是 Medium 任务，却需要仅存在于 Large 的 charge nurse，按声明的 pack 无法运行。
known_findings.measured_en: C-01 is now Large. review.py verifies requester and participant pack closure for every task.
known_findings.measured_zh: C-01 已改为 Large。review.py 现在检查每个任务的 requester 和 participants 是否都在 pack 内。

known_findings.finding_en: One discover mode hid a material product distinction between direct contacts and relay through the network.
known_findings.finding_zh: 单一 discover 模式掩盖了直接联系人和经网络转介之间的重要产品差异。
known_findings.measured_en: Direct Discover supports {direct_discover_count}/{task_count} tasks. Relay Discover now supports {relay_discover_count}/{task_count}: fourteen undersized hop budgets were repaired using existing two- or three-hop contact paths, without inventing contacts. Product consent for relay still needs confirmation.
known_findings.measured_zh: Direct Discover 支持 {direct_discover_count}/{task_count} 个任务；Relay Discover 现支持 {relay_discover_count}/{task_count} 个。14 个过小 hop budget 已使用现有 2–3 跳联系人路径修复，没有编造联系人；产品层 relay 同意机制仍需确认。

known_findings.finding_en: Role-named topology strings and two participant-count mismatches were not machine-checkable.
known_findings.finding_zh: 用岗位名书写的 topology，以及两处人数不匹配，无法可靠机检。
known_findings.measured_en: All topology strings now use canonical A/B/C notation; review.py parses them and requires the principal count to equal participants.
known_findings.measured_zh: 所有 topology 已统一为 A/B/C 记法；review.py 会解析并要求 principal 数与 participants 一致。

known_findings.finding_en: Many relational-policy cells target categories for which the owner currently has no note.
known_findings.finding_zh: 许多关系策略单元指向 owner 当前没有任何 note 的类别。
known_findings.measured_en: These are unexercised policy cells, not automatically fake data. The review page reports defined versus exercised coverage without inventing personal notes.
known_findings.measured_zh: 这些是尚未被实际 note 覆盖的策略单元，不应自动称为假数据。review 页面会区分已定义与已覆盖，不通过编造私人 note 来补数。

known_findings.finding_en: Termination, legal-hold conflict, restore testing, payment verification, medication shortage, results routing, and clinical-AI safety monitoring were missing or indirect.
known_findings.finding_zh: 离职、诉讼保全冲突、恢复测试、付款核验、药品短缺、结果路由和临床 AI 安全监测此前缺失或仅被间接覆盖。
known_findings.measured_en: The current task set covers these gaps. AI-01 now starts from a concrete Kestrel pilot crossing its documented threshold rather than a hypothetical company premise. Role ownership and frequency still require practitioner validation.
known_findings.measured_zh: 当前任务集已覆盖这些缺口。AI-01 现从 Kestrel 试用越过已记录阈值这一具体事件开始，不再依赖假设性公司前提。岗位 owner 与频率仍需从业者确认。

known_findings.finding_en: People Ops, vendor clinical safety, medication safety, and privacy-office coverage were previously implicit or missing.
known_findings.finding_zh: People Ops、供应商临床安全、用药安全和隐私办公室覆盖此前隐含或缺失。
known_findings.measured_en: The world now has 60 agents. Added operations roles cover HIM/record release, continuity, patient safety, communications, IAM, TechFlow support/reliability, and the external PEO. Exact titles and staffing remain assumptions requiring practitioners.
known_findings.measured_zh: 世界现有 60 个 agent。新增岗位覆盖 HIM/病历披露、连续性、患者安全、传播、IAM、TechFlow 支持/可靠性及外部 PEO。准确岗位名与人员配置仍是假设，需从业者确认。

known_findings.finding_en: Task audit found stale sole-authority language, candidate/employee state conflicts, near-duplicates, batch workflows mixed with deliberation, and vague completion evidence.
known_findings.finding_zh: 任务审查发现过时唯一审批措辞、候选人/员工状态冲突、近重复、批量 workflow 与判断任务混用，以及完成证据模糊。
known_findings.measured_en: {rewritten_count} tasks are materially rewritten and {new_count} are new. All 166 completion blocks and required-check sets are now task-specific rather than profile copies, and every task declares a Direct or Relay discovery requirement. Rubrics remain human-review drafts until gold reference cases exist.
known_findings.measured_zh: {rewritten_count} 个任务已实质重写，{new_count} 个为新增。166 个 completion 和 required-check 集合现均为任务专属，不再只是 profile 复制；每个任务也声明 Direct/Relay 发现要求。在 gold reference case 完成前，rubric 仍是待人工确认的草稿。

known_findings.finding_en: Putting operational roles directly into Small/Medium made every run pay for agents unrelated to the selected scenario.
known_findings.finding_zh: 把运营岗位直接放入 Small/Medium，会让每次实验都加载与当前场景无关的 agent。
known_findings.measured_en: The seven 60-agent expansion roles now enter Large first. Small/Medium return to 33/44 agents. Generated scenario and custom sets select the exact principal closure; future promotion remains an explicit benchmark-design decision.
known_findings.measured_zh: 新增 7 个角色现统一先进入 Large，Small/Medium 回到 33/44 人。生成的场景/custom 集合只选任务所需 principal 闭包；未来是否晋升仍是明确的 benchmark 设计决定。

known_findings.finding_en: Agent task counts were previously shown per person but not explained as an intentional workload spectrum.
known_findings.finding_zh: 此前虽然逐人显示任务数，但没有说明这是有意设计的工作负载光谱。
known_findings.measured_en: The build now classifies zero, light, ordinary, busy, and high-pressure roles. It preserves Jordan as intentionally task-free and does not create work merely to equalise counts.
known_findings.measured_zh: 页面现将角色分为零任务、低负载、普通、繁忙和高压；Jordan 有意保持零任务，不会为了拉平数字而编造工作。

known_findings.finding_en: Evaluation metadata was present but repeated profile templates rather than task-specific contracts.
known_findings.finding_zh: evaluation 元数据虽存在，但重复的是 profile 模板，而不是任务专属契约。
known_findings.measured_en: All 166 tasks now have distinct completion and required-check sets combining the concrete outcome, coordination boundary, profile controls, and forbidden-fact evidence. Each is honestly marked human_review_required and gold_status:not_built; scored execution remains blocked.
known_findings.measured_zh: 166 个任务现都有不同的 completion 和 required-check 集合，结合具体结果、协作边界、profile 控制和 forbidden-fact 证据。每项仍诚实标为 human_review_required 和 gold_status:not_built；正式计分继续受阻。

measurement.finding_en: Task appearances measure benchmark centrality and exposure, not calendar workload, staffing sufficiency, burnout, or FTE demand.
measurement.finding_zh: 任务出现次数衡量的是 benchmark 中心度和暴露面，不是日历工作量、人员是否充足、倦怠风险或 FTE 需求。
measurement.missing_inputs_en: A real workload model needs sourced event rates, effort or handling time, concurrency, requester versus reviewer effort, after-hours share, queue delay, delegation, and backup coverage.
measurement.missing_inputs_zh: 真实负载模型还需要有来源的事件率、处理时长、并发量、发起人与 reviewer 的投入差异、夜间占比、排队延迟、授权和替代覆盖。
measurement.decision_en: Keep the five bands as an editorial workload proxy. Do not interpret 25 appearances as a professional staffing threshold and do not equalise agents merely to change the chart.
measurement.decision_zh: 保留五档作为编辑性的负载代理指标；不得把 25 次出现解释为专业人员配置阈值，也不得为了改变图表而强行拉平 agent。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: A founder-CTO being central is plausible, but the benchmark routes engineering, hiring, scheduling, finance, incidents, product, and personal life through one person.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 创始 CTO 居于中心是合理的，但当前 benchmark 把工程、招聘、排期、财务、事故、产品和私人生活都汇聚到同一个人。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: The benchmark may reward 'ask Alex' as a shortcut and confuse personal-task exposure with CTO workload.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: benchmark 可能奖励“都去问 Alex”的捷径，并把私人任务暴露误当成 CTO 工作负载。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Report work and personal appearances separately; keep architecture and deploy authority, but confirm delegation for routine hiring, scheduling, and evidence collection.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 分开报告工作与私人任务；保留架构和部署权限，但确认日常招聘、排期和证据收集的授权下放。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: DevOps lead plus designated Security Officer is plausible in a small vendor, but operation, control ownership, evidence production, and security approval overlap heavily.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 小型供应商由 DevOps lead 兼指定 Security Officer 可以成立，但运行、控制 owner、证据生产和安全批准高度重叠。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: Insufficient separation between building or operating a control and independently reviewing its effectiveness or accepting residual business risk.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 控制的建设/运行与独立有效性 review、剩余业务风险接受之间分离不足。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Keep Priya as technical owner, but require a different risk acceptor and independent audit or review for material exceptions, access-audit evidence, and control failures.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: Priya 保持技术 owner；重大例外、访问审计证据和控制失败必须由不同的风险接受者及独立审计/reviewer 处理。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: Finance, Operations, and People Ops can be combined at a small startup, especially with a PEO and fractional controller, but the combination is not self-checking.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 小型创业公司在有 PEO 和兼职 controller 时可以合并财务、运营与 People Ops，但这种组合不能自我复核。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: Payroll preparation, vendor changes, benefits data, employee records, and operational approvals can collapse into one coordination hub.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 工资准备、供应商变更、福利数据、员工记录和运营审批可能塌缩为单一协调枢纽。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Preserve controller review, officer approval, PEO custody of medical evidence, and counsel escalation. Add an HR/Employee Relations role only if investigations, discipline, or accommodation become benchmark scope.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 保留 controller 复核、高管审批、PEO 保管医疗材料和律师升级。只有当调查、纪律或 accommodation 进入 benchmark 范围时才新增 HR/Employee Relations。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: A startup CEO carrying many reserved decisions is plausible; 35 appearances are not automatically excessive because many are approvals rather than execution.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 创业公司 CEO 承担大量保留事项是合理的；35 次出现不自动等于过载，因为很多只是审批而非执行。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: Routine transactions may still queue behind the CEO, and broad approval labels can look like unlimited personal authority.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 日常交易仍可能在 CEO 处排队，宽泛审批标签也可能看起来像无限个人权限。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Confirm monetary and contractual thresholds, reserved matters, countersignatures, named backup officers, and which tasks need only notification rather than approval.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 确认金额和合同阈值、保留事项、会签、具名替代高管，以及哪些任务只需通知而非审批。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: The role is explicitly part-time two days a week but appears in urgent incident, payment, separation, contracting, hiring, and finance workflows.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 该角色明确每周仅工作两天，却出现在紧急事故、付款、离职、合同、招聘和财务流程中。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: A same-day task may be structurally valid yet operationally impossible for up to four days if no outside-counsel or delegated cover exists.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 若没有外部律师或授权替代覆盖，同日任务即使结构正确，也可能在运营上最多四天无法完成。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: OFF-01 now uses Margaret as documented urgent outside-counsel cover. Confirm that the same retainer or another named route covers other urgent legal work; absence remains a legitimate partial or refusal result.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: OFF-01 现使用 Margaret 作为书面紧急外部律师覆盖。请确认同一聘用协议或另一具名路径也覆盖其他紧急法律工作；缺席仍是合法的部分完成或拒绝结果。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: The service desk should be highly connected, but a named manager is not the 24/7 service and should usually route, evidence, or escalate rather than own security and clinical decisions.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 服务台理应高度连接，但具名经理不是 7×24 服务本身，通常应负责路由、证据和升级，而不是拥有安全或临床决定。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: The current availability wording and 28 appearances can make the duty-manager rota look like Bea's personal availability and authority.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 当前可用时间表述和 28 次出现可能把 duty-manager 轮值误写成 Bea 个人的可用性和权限。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Separate Bea's personal hours from the service-desk rota; keep only password-reset approval and make incident, risk, and restoration decisions belong to their accountable owners.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 分开 Bea 的个人工时与服务台轮值；只保留密码重置审批，事故、风险和恢复决定归相应责任 owner。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: A senior engineer appearing across deploy, incident, product, hiring, onboarding, and on-call work is plausible during a concentrated product phase.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 高级工程师在产品集中交付期横跨部署、事故、产品、招聘、入职和 on-call 是合理的。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: The world may still create a technical key-person dependency if review, deployment knowledge, and incident recovery repeatedly require Mike.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 如果代码 review、部署知识和事故恢复反复依赖 Mike，世界仍可能形成技术关键人风险。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Keep the load, but review rotation, documentation, second reviewer coverage, and whether Lisa or Tom can finish selected workflows without Mike.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 保留该负载，但 review 轮值、文档、第二 reviewer 覆盖，以及 Lisa 或 Tom 是否能在没有 Mike 时完成部分流程。

high_pressure_reviews.judgement_en: A practising CMIO who chairs clinical governance and sponsors results-routing and medical-staff governance is plausible in a constrained health-system slice, but Naomi now sits exactly at the high-centrality threshold.
high_pressure_reviews.judgement_zh: 在受限医疗集团切片中，由仍执业的 CMIO 主持临床治理并 sponsor 结果路由和医务人员治理是合理的，但 Naomi 现在恰好进入高中心度阈值。
high_pressure_reviews.risk_en: Administrative preparation, routine routing, and evidence collection could queue behind a clinician-executive even when her judgement is only needed at the final governance gate.
high_pressure_reviews.risk_zh: 行政准备、日常路由和证据收集可能在临床高管处排队，即使真正只在最终治理 gate 需要她的判断。
high_pressure_reviews.action_en: Keep final clinical-governance judgement with Naomi, but delegate credential evidence to Nora, grievance process administration to Patrick, informatics evidence to Kenji, and committee preparation to the relevant coordinator. Confirm a deputy chair and quorum route.
high_pressure_reviews.action_zh: 最终临床治理判断保留给 Naomi，但把资质证据交 Nora、申诉流程行政交 Patrick、Informatics 证据交 Kenji、委员会准备交相应协调人；请确认 deputy chair 和 quorum 路径。

role_gaps.gap_en: Previously no one owned formal intake, time frames, response assembly, or governance routing.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 此前无人负责正式受理、时限、答复组装和治理路由。
role_gaps.decision_en: Patrick now coordinates the process in GRV-01; Patient Safety, Privacy, Communications, clinical governance, and the governing-body or grievance-committee boundary retain their decisions.
role_gaps.decision_zh: 现由 Patrick 在 GRV-01 协调流程；Patient Safety、Privacy、Communications、临床治理及治理机构/申诉委员会边界分别保留决定。

role_gaps.gap_en: Credential verification and privileging workflow previously had no administrative owner.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 资质核验与 privileging 流程此前没有行政 owner。
role_gaps.decision_en: Nora coordinates verification and records in MS-01; Naomi, peer clinical input, counsel, authorised medical-staff review, and governing-body authority stay separate.
role_gaps.decision_zh: Nora 在 MS-01 协调核验与记录；Naomi、同行临床意见、律师、有权 medical-staff review 和治理机构权限保持分离。

role_gaps.gap_en: No diagnostics medical owner exists in the 60-agent slice.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 60-agent 切片中没有诊断服务医疗 owner。
role_gaps.decision_en: RM-01 is now only an electronic routing-control and safety incident under Naomi's governance; interpretation and diagnostic-service policy are explicitly out of scope.
role_gaps.decision_zh: RM-01 现仅是 Naomi 治理下的电子路由控制与安全事件；诊断解释和诊断服务政策明确排除。

role_gaps.gap_en: The actual medical-necessity decision maker is outside the PACT-Net world.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 真实医疗必要性决策者不在 PACT-Net 世界。
role_gaps.decision_en: Patrick coordinates the packet and timing; RCM-01 ends at routing and tracked external decision. No internal agent impersonates the payer reviewer.
role_gaps.decision_zh: Patrick 协调材料和时限；RCM-01 止于路由与外部决定追踪，没有内部 agent 冒充支付方 reviewer。

role_gaps.gap_en: Kestrel workforce administration is not represented.
role_gaps.gap_zh: Kestrel 员工管理没有被建模。
role_gaps.decision_en: Do not add workforce discipline, accommodation, occupational-health, payroll, union, or investigation tasks while holding at 60 agents.
role_gaps.decision_zh: 固定 60 人期间，不新增 Kestrel 纪律、accommodation、职业健康、工资、工会或员工调查任务。

role_gaps.gap_en: Medication Safety previously looked able to own enterprise substitution and stock action alone.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 此前 Medication Safety 看起来能单独拥有全系统替代与库存行动。
role_gaps.decision_en: Leah coordinates P&T evidence; committee or pharmacy leadership remains the non-agent approval boundary for enterprise policy and stock action.
role_gaps.decision_zh: Leah 协调 P&T 证据；委员会或药房领导作为非 agent 审批边界保留全系统政策与库存行动权限。

role_gaps.gap_en: Control owners cannot independently audit themselves.
role_gaps.gap_zh: 控制 owner 不能独立审计自己。
role_gaps.decision_en: Nora coordinates compliance evidence and Priya operates technical controls; independent review and residual-risk acceptance remain external or committee boundaries, not extra agents.
role_gaps.decision_zh: Nora 协调合规证据，Priya 运行技术控制；独立 review 与剩余风险接受保留为外部/委员会边界，不新增 agent。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: New formal-grievance task makes process ownership real while retaining governing-body accountability. Human confirmation is still required for local scope, time frames, signer, and committee route.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 新增正式申诉任务，使流程 owner 真实，同时保留治理机构责任；仍需人工确认本地范围、时限、签署人和委员会路径。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: New credentialing task separates administrative verification, clinical recommendation, legal/bylaw review, and governing-body decision; local bylaws remain human-review evidence.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 新增资质任务分离行政核验、临床推荐、法律/章程 review 与治理机构决定；本地章程仍需人工确认。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired by narrowing to electronic routing control and patient-safety closure. It no longer claims complete diagnostic-service governance.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已收窄为电子路由控制与患者安全关闭，不再宣称完整诊断服务治理。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired as a minimum-necessary packet, expedited routing, and external-decision tracking task. No PACT-Net agent makes the payer clinical determination.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已修为最小必要材料、加急路由和外部决定追踪任务；没有 PACT-Net agent 作支付方临床裁定。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired by making Leah the evidence/P&T coordinator and reserving enterprise policy and stock decisions to committee or pharmacy leadership.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已将 Leah 限定为证据/P&T 协调人，全系统政策与库存决定保留给委员会或药房领导。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired by using Margaret as documented urgent outside-counsel cover instead of requiring part-time Elena on every effective date.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已改用 Margaret 作为书面紧急外部律师覆盖，不再要求兼职 Elena 在每个生效日都在线。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired as a finance dual-control workflow. Counsel is conditional on contracting-entity or authority ambiguity, not a routine queue.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已修为财务双人控制流程；律师仅在合同主体或权限有歧义时触发，不是日常必经队列。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: Repaired to apply only to an actual in-scope clinically material model crossing a documented threshold; the task does not establish regulated-device status.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 已限定为真实范围内、具有临床影响且超过书面阈值的模型；本任务不证明医疗器械监管属性。

task_boundary_reviews.finding_en: No further edit required: it remains tied to an applicable recorded reverification window, not every employee or document.
task_boundary_reviews.finding_zh: 无需继续修改：任务仍绑定适用的记录复核窗口，不适用于每名员工或每份文件。

references.label_en: HHS — Summary of the HIPAA Security Rule
references.use_en: Security official, workforce access, incidents, contingency planning, audit controls, and scalable safeguards.
references.use_zh: 用于核对 security official、员工访问、事故、连续性计划、审计控制和可扩展保障。

references.label_en: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3 — separation of duties and least privilege
references.label_zh: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3——职责分离与最小权限
references.use_en: Supports the review of Priya, access administration, independent audit, and privileged functions.
references.use_zh: 用于审查 Priya、访问管理、独立审计和特权功能边界。

references.label_en: 42 CFR 482.13 — Patient rights and grievance process
references.use_en: Supports the conditional Patient Relations / grievance-owner gap.
references.use_zh: 用于支持 Patient Relations / grievance owner 的条件性缺口。

references.label_en: 42 CFR 482.22 — Medical staff credentialing and privileging
references.use_en: Supports the Medical Staff Services / Credentialing gap.
references.use_zh: 用于支持 Medical Staff Services / Credentialing 缺口。

references.use_en: Bounds H-15 reverification; it is not universal to every employee or document.
references.use_zh: 限定 H-15 的 reverification 范围；并非所有员工或文件都适用。

references.label_en: FDA — Postmarket monitoring of AI-enabled medical devices
references.label_zh: FDA——AI 医疗器械上市后监测
references.use_en: Supports monitoring for input change, output performance, and drift while leaving product regulatory status unproven.
references.use_zh: 支持输入变化、输出性能和漂移监测，但不据此认定产品监管属性。

agent_count_policy.decision_en: Freeze the world at exactly 60 agents. Resolve current functional gaps through explicit multi-hat assignments and committee or external decision boundaries; do not create another agent unless future scope adds sustained execution work that existing owners cannot plausibly absorb.
agent_count_policy.decision_zh: 世界固定为恰好 60 个 agent。当前职能缺口通过明确身兼数职及委员会/外部决定边界解决；只有未来范围新增持续执行工作且现有 owner 无法合理承接时，才考虑新增 agent。
